hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]].*\bcommit\b' || exit 0; REPO=$(echo "$CMD" | grep -oE -- '-C [^[:space:]]+' | awk '{print $2}' | head -1); if [ -n "$REPO" ]; then git -C "$REPO" push 2>&1; else git push 2>&1; fi || true
